Nina (Partnerships): Quick kickoff: we need to finalize marketplace regional go-live windows + SI SDK handoff. proposing EU Fri 2026-04-09 07:00 UTC, APAC Tue 2026-04-13 03:00 UTC. canary then ramp. objections?
Ravi (Eng): EU time okay. need a staging preview for partner collateral by Wed EOD. will require the listing JSON and sample images.
Sofia (Product): landing pages must be localized (DE/FR/JP). can we commit to translation delivery Thu noon? also which SKUs go public vs partner-preview?
Caleb (Marketing): embargo windows: EU needs 48h, APAC 72h for local media teams. blog + press kit in progress, I'll DM draft link.
Priya (Sales): partner asks: sample listing screenshot & hero assets. also legal wants co-marketing terms executed before logos go live.
Ken (SI): SI can start integration tests once SDK + terraform examples are in staging. need short-lived CI token for on-prem runs.
Ravi (Eng): uploading SDK + terraform sample to s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/179901 today. will post link here.
Nina (Partnerships): action items: @Ravi upload artifacts, @Ken schedule cert window Thu 15:00 UTC, @Caleb confirm embargo cadence, @Priya collect logos/contracts, @Sofia lock SKU visibility.
LegalBot: Reminder: trademark use and co-marketing terms must be signed before partner logos are published. allow 2 business days for EU, 3 for APAC.
Caleb (Marketing): ack. will route contracts to Legal and notify partners about timelines.
Ravi (Eng): artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/179901/sdk-1.0.zip and s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/179901/terraform-example.tar.gz. staging URL will be https://staging.marketplace.redwood.ai/179901 once listing is drafted.
Ken (SI): received artifacts, booking cert slot Thu 15:00 UTC. please provide sample data and CI token.
Priya (Sales): pinging partner C for logos and signed co-marketing. ETA Wed AM.
Sofia (Product): canary plan below, confirm rollback thresholds: p95 latency, error rate, and token cost delta.
```
canary:
  step1: 10% traffic -> 30min
  step2: 30% traffic -> 1h
  step3: 60% traffic -> 2h
  full: proceed if metrics OK
rollback_criteria: error_rate > 2% or p95 > 2x SLA
```
Nina (Partnerships): good. contingency: soft-launch without partner logos if legal delays. feature-flag will hide partner badges. next sync Wed 16:00 UTC to verify staging preview. thanks all. :rocket:
